The fleet

Four Cessna 162 Skycatchers. One trusted trainer.

A single-type fleet keeps training simple — students, instructors and mechanics all work one airframe, one panel, one checklist. Each aircraft is delivered inspected, documented and ready for your flight line.

Delivery & safety

Delivered airworthy and lease-ready.

Every aircraft leaves us inspected, documented and ready for the flight line. Once it's on lease, your school operates and maintains it day to day — but it always starts from a clean, airworthy baseline.

✓
Fresh annual & 100-hour at handoverEach airframe is delivered with current inspections signed off, so day one on your line is a flying day.
✓
Airworthiness Directives currentAll applicable ADs and service bulletins complied with and documented per tail number at delivery.
✓
ADS-B Out equippedEvery aircraft is 2020-mandate compliant and ready for controlled airspace.
✓
Garmin G300 glass panelThe same modern avionics across all four airframes — one panel your CFIs and students learn once.
✓
Complete, documented logbooksFull maintenance history handed over with the aircraft, so you know exactly what you're operating.

No capital tied up

Lease instead of buying a six-figure airframe. A predictable monthly cost, and none of the purchase or resale risk on your books.

Turnkey handover

Aircraft arrive inspected, documented and positioned on your field — you're flying and teaching, not ferrying or chasing paperwork.

Single-type simplicity

Four identical Skycatchers mean one checklist, one parts list and one type your instructors and mechanics already know cold.
